hints.title: Pair Target Construction
hints.text: For two elements nums[i] and nums[j], the cost to make both have bitwise and containing target mask is the sum of increments required.

hints.title: Cost to Meet Mask
hints.text: For a value x and bit target T, the minimal y >= x such that (y & T) == T can be found by filling missing bits.

hints.title: Greedy Bit Testing
hints.text: Test bits from most significant (bit 30) down to 0, greedily appending bit b to candidate mask if a pair exists with cost <= k.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all 2^30 potential bitwise values is intractable.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects bitwise greedy search from most significant bit to least significant bit.
